si_4_title.answer: Investigating dopaminergic abnormalities in schizophrenia and first-episode psychosis with normative modelling and multisite molecular neuroimaging

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Voxel-wise NMs of dopamine receptor density and dopamine synthesis capacity were estimated using Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) with the PCNToolkit library.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: After data harmonisation, Bayesian Linear Regression (BLR) was used to estimate voxel-wise NMs (i.e., one model per grey matter voxel) of dopamine receptor density and dopamine synthesis capacity from [11C]-(+)-PHNO and [18F]FDOPA data of the HC samples.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: [11C]-(+)-PHNO PET was used to measure D2/3 dopamine receptor density (BPND, non-displaceable binding potential). [18F]FDOPA PET was used to measure dopamine synthesis capacity (Ki_cer, influx rate constant).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: In short, dopamine D2/3 receptor density was measured using non-displaceable binding potential (BPND [49]) as the parameter of interest. ... Dopamine synthesis capacity indicated by the parameter Ki cer (sometimes indicated as Ki, min -1 ) was quantified with the Gjedde-Patlak graphical method using the cerebellum as the reference region.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Giacomel2025.pdf.md: METHODS / Study datasets / [11C]-(+)-PHNO Datasets; [18F]FDOPA datasets

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and sex were used for [18F]FDOPA models. Age, sex, and BMI were used for [11C]-(+)-PHNO models.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In this case, the selected independent variables were sex, age, and BMI for [11C]-(+)-PHNO, and age and sex for [18F]FDOPA.
